hubs.source_summary: California intrastate household-goods movers are regulated by the Bureau of Household Goods and Services (Department of Consumer Affairs). Interstate authority is a separate FMCSA universe. MoveTrustHub /california is live.
hubs.coverage_summary: CAL-T is not USDOT. California intrastate authority is not FMCSA interstate authority. FMCSA ACTIVE is not a California license. A California license is not interstate authorization. A license is not confirmed current insurance. A citation is not a revocation. A tariff is not an actual price. A complaint is not a violation. Complete CAL-T roster is SOURCE_NOT_ACQUIRED. Licensed-mover denominator is UNKNOWN, not zero. Complaint bulk history was not acquired. No profile attachments. No California county routes.
verified_facts: Current regulator is the California Department of Consumer Affairs, Bureau of Household Goods and Services. CAL-T is not a USDOT number. CPUC is not the current household-goods regulator.
Complete CAL-T roster is SOURCE_NOT_ACQUIRED; licensed-mover denominator is UNKNOWN, not zero. Live FMCSA interstate records with a California business/HQ location: 397 — not California licenses.

Official BHGS citations under BPC 19237: 132 rows (120 labeled UNLICENSED by the source, 12 exact CAL-T/T identifiers). A citation is not a revocation. Maximum Rate Tariff 4 is effective 2026-01-01; a tariff is not an actual price. State insurance requirements are filing requirements, not proof of current coverage. Complaint bulk history was not acquired. No profile attachments.
routing_intents: How do I verify a mover inside California?
Can the same mover take me from California to Nevada?

hubs.source_summary: LenderTrustHub publishes HMDA 2025 California market activity, a CalHFA participation directory, and CRMLA 2024 annual-report context. A current CRMLA bulk roster is not acquired.
hubs.coverage_summary: HMDA is not a California mortgage-license roster. Denial rate is not quality. CalHFA participation is not an endorsement. The CRMLA annual report is not a current live roster. An NMLS ID is not current California authority by itself. CURRENT_CRMLA_BULK_ROSTER = SOURCE_NOT_ACQUIRED.
semantic_guardrails: CRMLA annual report ≠ current live roster
NMLS ID ≠ current CA authority by itself
verified_facts: HMDA 2025 California: 1,014,489 applications, 569,218 originations, 175,802 denials (17.33% denial rate). Denial rate is not quality.
CalHFA approved-lender directory: 1,414 rows, 193 distinct company names, 1,341 phones, 0 emails, 0 NMLS IDs. Participation is not an endorsement.
CRMLA 2024 annual report (Oct 2025): 389 licensees and 5,104 branches as of 2024-12-31. That report is not a current live roster.
routing_intents: What mortgage activity do you have for California?
gap_examples: NMLS IDs on the CalHFA directory

hubs.source_summary: InsuranceTrustHub publishes DMHC enforcement and IMR evidence, a dated CDI health-insurer list, and FAIR Plan residual-market context. DMHC and CDI are separate regulator universes.
hubs.coverage_summary: DMHC is not CDI. An IMR is not a complaint or an enforcement finding, and it does not mean an insurer violated the law. An accusation is not a final finding. FAIR Plan is not the entire market. The 28-company CDI health-insurer list is not all California insurers. NAIC identity is not California authorization.
verified_facts: DMHC enforcement trend: 5,435 rows. DMHC Independent Medical Review: 42,749 determinations. An IMR is not a finding that an insurer violated the law.
CDI dated health-insurer list: 28 companies (phones 28/28, websites 27/28). That list is not all California insurers.
DMHC is not CDI. FAIR Plan is residual-market context, not the entire market.
routing_intents: What does California insurance enforcement show?
Does an IMR mean my insurer violated the law?

hubs.topic: Senior care facilities and home-care research
hubs.source_summary: SeniorTrustHub publishes separate California universes: ELMS, RCFE, HCAI, HCO, and a CMS overlay. These are not one combined provider count.
hubs.coverage_summary: Do not present a combined “California senior providers” number. RCFE is not a nursing home / SNF. HCO is not HHA. CDPH is not CMS. An HCAI record is not a unique new provider. A facility address is not a service area. ARF is researched and not published.
semantic_guardrails: do not add universes into one California senior-provider count
verified_facts: ELMS lists 15,097 California locations as of 2026-08-17 (13,401 ACTIVE), with 13,560 facility phones and 12,435 emails in that snapshot.
RCFE is 12,522 rows as of 2025-05-25 (7,939 LICENSED). An RCFE is not a nursing home.
These universes are not additive. Do not treat them as one California senior-providers count.
routing_intents: Is an RCFE the same thing as a nursing home?
